closedByA85.title: Shield Pro fetched only the first 100 rows
closedByA85.closure: A bounded 250-row pagination loop walks up to 20 canonical pages, deduplicates exact IDs and stops only on a short final page.

closedByA85.title: A repeated provider page could create a false complete catalog
closedByA85.closure: Pagination detects a non-advancing page and returns an explicit partial blocker.

closedByA85.title: A later-page outage could erase the distinction between partial and complete coverage
closedByA85.closure: Rows already fetched are retained with mode=partial and an exact later-page failure blocker.

closedByA85.title: Shield Pro batch requests did not explicitly bind the free delivery tier
closedByA85.closure: Every catalog page sends tier=basic; paid depth remains a separate account-bound route.

closedByA85.title: Shield Map accepted unknown query parameters
closedByA85.closure: The server rejects every parameter outside query and locale.

closedByA85.title: Duplicate query or locale parameters could shadow identity
closedByA85.closure: Duplicate security-relevant parameters are rejected before provider work.

closedByA85.title: Shield Map query length, control and bidi characters were not centrally bounded
closedByA85.closure: A 120-byte strict query boundary and 2048-byte URL ceiling reject control and bidi input.

closedByA85.title: A fuzzy CoinGecko suggestion could be published as the requested asset
closedByA85.closure: CoinGecko output is used only when an integrity-valid provider receipt proves exact requested identity.

closedByA85.title: Ambiguous symbol or market resolution could continue to risk analysis
closedByA85.closure: Unresolved identity fails closed with HTTP 409 before investigator publication.

closedByA85.title: An EVM address could be accepted without an exact chain binding
closedByA85.closure: Address requests require exact address equality and a non-empty resolved chain ID.

closedByA85.title: A tampered provider identity receipt could authorize Shield Map
closedByA85.closure: Provider receipt integrity is recomputed before identity credit.

closedByA85.title: The Shield Map deep-dive toggle could be mistaken for paid analysis
closedByA85.closure: The response and UI contract fix deepDivePresentationOnly=true and VLM depth=basic.

closedByA85.title: Pro and Advanced delivery lacked one full-catalog entitlement proof
closedByA85.closure: All 636 paid packets remain blocked until a real server-owned account entitlement is verified.

closedByA85.title: Symbol-only inference could promote paid Shield Map depth
closedByA85.closure: Pro and Advanced map readiness require exact multi-source chain/address consensus.

closedByA85.title: Wallet or entity labels could be promoted without signed current evidence
closedByA85.closure: Advanced map readiness requires SIGNED_CURRENT labels; stale, conflict and missing stay blocked.

closedByA85.title: Investigator lane completeness lacked a full-catalog denominator
closedByA85.closure: Every tier packet binds all six lanes: supply, unlock, liquidity, insider, social and contract.

closedByA85.title: Shield Pro and Shield Map could drift on market identity
closedByA85.closure: Both surfaces bind the same canonical marketId, symbol and USD quote.

closedByA85.title: Terminal timeframe coverage was not proven across all tiers
closedByA85.closure: Six exact ranges are bound for every one of 954 tier packets.

closedByA85.title: Advanced could become ready on stale or conflicted order-book depth
closedByA85.closure: Paid terminal readiness requires AVAILABLE depth and preserves stale/conflict blockers.

closedByA85.title: Offline functional readiness could be mistaken for paid delivery
closedByA85.closure: Functional readiness and real delivery decisions are separate fields; paidDelivered remains zero.

closedByA85.title: Re-signed identity, binding, entitlement and depth mutations were not tested jointly
closedByA85.closure: Sixteen semantic mutation families are re-sealed for every tier packet and must fail verification.

closedByA85.title: Real Shield Pro/Map evidence had no exact denominator
closedByA85.closure: A fail-closed 318-asset intake requires pagination, identity, binding, labels, depth, browser, entitlement, rights and customer labels.

closedByA85.title: A85 could be promoted without an exact A80 candidate
closedByA85.closure: All A85 packets remain exactA80CandidateBound=false and ineligible for promotion.

closedByA85.title: Injected fixture evidence could be described as current public-network execution
closedByA85.closure: The runtime records zero real cases, browser assets, rights, entitlements and customer labels.

closedByA85.title: A84 descendant verification treated A84 as permanently current
closedByA85.closure: A84 frozen payload remains exact while lineage is verified through the authority-bound A85 child.

closedByA85.title: Current metadata and completion program still pointed at A84
closedByA85.closure: Active pass, authority, compatibility mirror, package metadata and roadmap program are advanced together to A85.

closedByA85.title: The completion program omitted the authoritative remainingAfterA85 denominator
closedByA85.closure: The A76-A110 program records remainingAfterA85=25 and historical matrix verifiers derive the current remainder from authority.

closedByA85.title: The A78 bootstrap verifier hardcoded A83 as the permanently current superseding source
closedByA85.closure: A78 preserves its frozen policy and blocked exact-artifact truth while resolving current source, authority and active pass dynamically.

closedByA85.title: The route-dispatch manifest retained the pre-A85 investigator handler digest
closedByA85.closure: The exact investigator handler SHA-256 is rebound after strict Shield Map identity hardening; all 1320 dispatch checks must pass.

closedByA85.title: The canonical current-status test hardcoded A84 as the first roadmap revision
closedByA85.closure: Roadmap precedence now derives the exact current revision from current-release authority while preserving the required historical sections and A32 canonical rows.

truthBoundary: A85 proves local injected full-catalog Shield Pro and Shield Map identity, pagination, binding, depth, lane and entitlement semantics. It does not prove current public-network coverage, rights, real account entitlements, production browser behavior, customer value, LIVE or sale readiness.
